name: Účtovníctvo a financie
description: Pojmy z oblast účtovníctva - I. časť
author: Techdoc

words.definition: Strict economic policies or conditions aimed at reducing spending and limiting public expenditure.
words.example_en: The government introduced austerity measures after the financial crisis.
words.example_sk: Vláda zaviedla úsporné opatrenia po finančnej kríze.

words.definition: The ease with which an asset can be converted into cash without significantly affecting its price.
words.example_en: High liquidity allows investors to buy and sell assets quickly.
words.example_sk: Vysoká likvidita umožňuje investorom rýchlo nakupovať a predávať aktíva.

words.definition: Causing or relating to inflation, especially a general rise in prices and a fall in the purchasing value of money.
words.example_en: The government introduced measures to reduce inflationary pressure in the economy.
words.example_sk: Vláda zaviedla opatrenia na zníženie inflačného tlaku v ekonomike.

words.definition: A state in which something stops developing, growing, or making progress.
words.example_en: The economy suffered a long period of stagnation.

words.definition: The reduction or removal of government rules and controls in a particular industry or sector.
words.example_en: Deregulation of the airline industry increased competition.

words.definition: Related to an economic recession or a period of declining economic activity.
words.example_en: The country faced recessionary pressures after the financial crisis.
words.example_sk: Krajina čelila recesným tlakom po finančnej kríze.

words.definition: Relating to the economy as a whole, including inflation, unemployment, and national income.
words.example_en: The report examines major macroeconomic trends in the region.
words.example_sk: Správa skúma hlavné makroekonomické trendy v regióne.

words.definition: The process of transferring ownership or control of a business, industry, or service from the public sector to private ownership.
words.example_en: The government announced the privatization of the national railway company.
words.example_sk: Vláda oznámila privatizáciu národnej železničnej spoločnosti.

words.definition: The act of sharing out or distributing something again, often to make things more equal.
words.example_en: The policy aims at the redistribution of wealth.
words.example_sk: Politika sa zameriava na prerozdelenie bohatstva.

words.definition: The act of guessing or forming ideas about something without definite proof.
words.example_en: The report is based on speculation rather than evidence.
words.example_sk: Správa je založená na špekulácii, nie na dôkazoch.

words.definition: The system of public taxation and government revenue, or matters related to tax policy.
words.example_en: The minister proposed reforms in fiscality to increase state revenue.
words.example_sk: Minister navrhol reformy vo fiskalite s cieľom zvýšiť štátne príjmy.

words.definition: An economic policy of protecting domestic industries by restricting imports through tariffs, quotas, or other measures.
words.example_en: The government adopted protectionism to support local manufacturers.
words.example_sk: Vláda prijala protekcionizmus na podporu miestnych výrobcov.

words.definition: A slowing down in the rate of inflation, meaning prices are still rising but at a slower pace than before.
words.example_en: The central bank welcomed signs of disinflation in the economy.
words.example_sk: Centrálna banka privítala známky dezinflácie v ekonomike.

words.definition: The process of reducing debt or financial leverage.
words.example_en: The company began deleveraging after the financial crisis.
words.example_sk: Spoločnosť začala znižovať zadlženosť po finančnej kríze.

words.definition: The process of turning financial assets, such as loans or mortgages, into securities that can be sold to investors.
words.example_en: Securitization allowed the bank to sell bundles of mortgages to investors.
words.example_sk: Sekuritizácia umožnila banke predať balíky hypoték investorom.

words.definition: An economic policy in which a central bank buys financial assets to increase the money supply and support the economy.
words.example_en: The central bank used quantitative easing to stimulate economic growth.
words.example_sk: Centrálna banka použila kvantitatívne uvoľňovanie na podporu hospodárskeho rastu.
